summary: PERFORMANCE REGRESSION CHECK PASSED. Backend timing via public URL: /api/doctors cold 1.0s / cached 0.083s; ?system=ayurveda cold 0.99s / cached 0.13s; fresh-uncached query 0.56s; /api/doctors/11 0.95s, /doctors/12 0.97s — all within targets (cold <3s, cache-hit ~instant server-side; the 80-130ms on cache hits is ingress network latency, not server time). Data correctness intact: 20 items/page, total 61, every item has name/specialty/rating/review_count populated and specializations as array. pytest 6/6 passed. Frontend: /(tabs)/consult rendered doctor cards in 1.85s (count pill '61 Vaidyas', fees with ₹, gender placeholder avatars, no hanging skeletons); /doctor/12 Neha Panchal profile in 1.65s with female placeholder hero, fee row ₹800, book button. NOTE: initial pytest run showed a 22.8s 'cold' call — RCA: uvicorn runs with --reload watching /app/backend, and creating my new test file at /app/backend/tests/test_doctor_perf_regression.py triggered a mid-test backend restart (remote-MySQL ensure_indexes at startup). Artifact of the test harness, not a real regression; rerun passed clean.

minor.issue: uvicorn --reload watches /app/backend including tests/ — any test-file write triggers a full backend restart (~40-60s with remote-MySQL index sync), dropping in-memory caches and stalling in-flight requests. Consider excluding tests/ from watch dirs or disabling reload in this environment.

action_items: Optional: add --reload-exclude 'tests/*' (or move tests out of the watched tree) so future test runs don't restart the backend mid-test.
No functional fixes needed — performance fixes verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _doctor_dir_page: COUNT+SELECT parallelized via asyncio.gather, 30s TTL cache keyed by (system,city,q,page,page_size) with 200-entry eviction — correct and matches spec.
serialize_doctor_public ctx=None path now reuses _prefetch_doctor_context (4 concurrent queries) — verified /api/doctors/11 and /12 respond <1s with correct data.
msdb.py pool_recycle present (line 515) — no dead-idle-connection stalls observed across the test run.
Verified serializer data shape survived the refactor: specialty resolved from batched primary_specs map, rating/review_count from batched reviews, status from batched doctor_status.

rca_of_issue: Initial 22.8s 'cold' /api/doctors reading was a test-harness artifact: WatchFiles reloader detected the newly created tests/test_doctor_perf_regression.py and restarted uvicorn mid-request (startup pays remote-MySQL ensure_indexes). Confirmed via supervisor logs ('WatchFiles detected changes in tests/test_doctor_perf_regression.py. Reloading...').
